name: highway-atlas
description: An interactive bilingual atlas of the North American highway network

scripts.fetch: node tools/fetch-source.mjs && node tools/fetch-fhwa.mjs && node tools/fetch-hpms.mjs
scripts.fetch:ca: node tools/fetch-canada.mjs && node tools/fetch-canada-nhs.mjs && node tools/fetch-canada-traffic.mjs
scripts.fetch:mx: node tools/fetch-mexico.mjs && node tools/fetch-mexico-traffic.mjs && node tools/fetch-mexico-designations.mjs
scripts.fetch:all: npm run fetch && npm run fetch:ca && npm run fetch:qc && npm run fetch:mx && npm run fetch:bridges && npm run fetch:borders && npm run fetch:tolls
scripts.build: node tools/build-data.mjs && node tools/build-crossings.mjs && node tools/build-tolls.mjs && node tools/build-content.mjs
scripts.test: node tools/check-i18n.mjs && node tools/build-content.mjs && node tools/check-data.mjs && node tools/readme-figures.mjs
